import io,tarfile,base64,hashlib,json,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
raw=base64.b64decode('');assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='c1b33b368fac9ab9d1e603557ac899eda39c58950ebfb45bf0a0faaaf515ce09'
control=Path('/datasets/nuscenes-full/hugsim/iter145_resume_20261010');packet=control/'map_packet';packet.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as a:
 for t in a.getmembers():assert t.isfile() and not Path(t.name).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(t.name).parts
 a.extractall(packet)
for n,h in {'experiments/iter145_constrained_execution/assets.py': '58e75e71f694e7f55e62388d796bff72c5b6870297fa1e9b5922c9d5c1fb2acd', 'experiments/iter145_constrained_execution/maps.py': '808bec7d883cf1c22fed9d457fecd7613f0a8c97c6ed5a3482cfdedfd843fe16', 'experiments/iter145_constrained_execution/resources.py': 'af399059024d96431ff71d8041618fb51a0189a5d39cf080aeeebbbac33109de', 'experiments/iter145_constrained_execution/ACTOR_FILES.json': '2399f517f0521fb6adac52a73c30bb9b1e972ac2e9537c20fff91b224f30ca54', 'experiments/iter144_timed_trajectory/trajectory.py': '1efebe32277e403d8ed580354e33f79fc0625b0ce422d376725540f3644d861b', 'experiments/iter143_model_contract/proof/case_inventory.json': 'ead62a973036f253727ac19d878454506eff739663dd52dc02a9088e308e1cbf'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((packet/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
py='/opt/sentinel-stack/HUGSIM/.pixi/envs/default/bin/python'
p=subprocess.run([py,'-m','experiments.iter145_constrained_execution.maps','--output',str(control/'map_inventory.json')],cwd=packet,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=630)
r=dict(returncode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr)
if (control/'map_inventory.json').exists():r['map_inventory']=json.loads((control/'map_inventory.json').read_text())
